item.description: Archlaos #6852 the Twice-Born and Hypsstratos #5737 the Twice-Born fought in the Field of Ares. Both limp now; neither will forget.

item.title: Hypsstratos #5737 the Twice-Born's bones re-knit in the Asphodel Meadow and walked back to
item.description: Hypsstratos #5737 the Twice-Born's bones re-knit in the Asphodel Meadow and walked back to the Field of Ares. Only fire unmakes the Sown. Hypsstratos has drunk from Lethe 2 times and remembers little.

item.title: Agathides #5701 was broken in the archipelago (brawl). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel
item.description: Agathides #5701 was broken in the archipelago (brawl). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.
